usehooks-ts useDebounceValue.description:
Debounce a value and get a setter for it. Requires useDebounceValue from usehooks-ts.

防抖一个值，并获得它的 setter；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useDebounceValue。

usehooks-ts useDebounceCallback.description:
Create a debounced callback that also exposes cancel and flush. Requires useDebounceCallback from usehooks-ts.

创建带 cancel 与 flush 的防抖回调；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useDebounceCallback。

body: const { value: ${1:isOpen}, setTrue, setFalse, toggle } = useBoolean(${2:false});
usehooks-ts useBoolean.description:
Manage a boolean with stable actions. This hook returns an object, unlike the ahooks hook of the same name which returns a tuple. Requires useBoolean from usehooks-ts.

使用稳定操作管理布尔值；该 Hook 返回对象，与 ahooks 同名 Hook 返回数组不同。需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useBoolean。

usehooks-ts useToggle.description:
Manage a boolean as a tuple of value, toggle and setter. Requires useToggle from usehooks-ts.

以「值、toggle、setter」三元组管理布尔值；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useToggle。

usehooks-ts useLocalStorage.description:
Persist state to localStorage, with a remover. Set initializeWithValue to false for server rendering. Requires useLocalStorage from usehooks-ts and a browser environment.

将状态持久化到 localStorage 并提供清除函数；服务端渲染时将 initializeWithValue 设为 false。需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useLocalStorage，并运行在浏览器环境。

usehooks-ts useOnClickOutside.description:
Run a handler for clicks outside one ref or an array of refs. Requires useOnClickOutside from usehooks-ts and a target ref.

点击单个 ref 或一组 ref 之外时执行回调；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useOnClickOutside 和目标 ref。

usehooks-ts useEventListener.description:
Subscribe to a DOM event with automatic cleanup; the target defaults to window, or pass a ref as the third argument. Requires useEventListener from usehooks-ts.

订阅 DOM 事件并自动清理，目标默认为 window，也可将 ref 作为第三个参数传入；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useEventListener。

body: const { count: ${1:count}, increment, decrement, reset } = useCounter(${2:0});
usehooks-ts useCounter.description:
Manage a numeric counter. This hook returns an object, unlike the ahooks and react-use hooks of the same name which return a tuple. Requires useCounter from usehooks-ts.

管理数值计数器；该 Hook 返回对象，与 ahooks、react-use 同名 Hook 返回数组不同。需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useCounter。

usehooks-ts useMediaQuery.description:
Track a CSS media query. Requires useMediaQuery from usehooks-ts.

跟踪 CSS 媒体查询；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useMediaQuery。

usehooks-ts useCopyToClipboard.description:
Copy text to the clipboard and read the last copied value. Requires useCopyToClipboard from usehooks-ts and a secure context.

复制文本到剪贴板并读取上次复制的值；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useCopyToClipboard，并运行在安全上下文中。

usehooks-ts useInterval.description:
Run a callback on an interval; pass null as the delay to pause it. Requires useInterval from usehooks-ts.

按间隔执行回调，delay 传 null 可暂停；需要从 usehooks-ts 导入 useInterval。
